verdict.rationale: The docs give a short install-then-init path (`npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, then `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` followed by a write of the selected skill files for Codex and Claude Code). Hands-on probes confirm `npx` runs and the dry run previews SKILL.md creation for both harness targets without a login. However, the installed skill's hosted process functions all return AUTH_REQUIRED until a device-code login is approved by a human, and no source documents a single quickstart or a timed run. missing for 10: a dedicated end-to-end quickstart page, evidence of the under-five-minute timing, an observed non-dry-run `init` write, and a working skill without a separate human-approved auth step.
